newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Olympia seeks share suspension.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Olympia seeks share suspension.

text.p: Malaysian gaming and property firm Olympia Industries Bhd on Friday requested the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) to suspend trading in its shares from Monday pending an announcement.
In a statement to the KLSE the company gave no reasons and its officials were not available for comment.
Olympia has been making substantial investments in property development recently including a 750 million ringgit residential property in Kuala Lumpur.

It has also secured a casino licence in South Africa and a lottery licence in Cambodia after its gaming licence in Malaysia's eastern Sabah state was not renewed by the government in January this year.
